phases.title: Define Binary Physical Format Law
acceptance: byte order, field widths, magic, version, page sizes, alignment, and reserved-field policy are typed law
host-endian, serde-order, unsupported page-size, and unknown reserved-field declarations are rejected

phases.instructions: Make persisted bytes deterministic before references, headers, pages, or manifests can claim reopen authority. Do not write Rust struct layout, serde map order, enum discriminants, pointer width, or host endianness to disk as law.
phases.qa_focus: Serializer accidents, implicit host assumptions, reserved-field misuse, cross-platform fixture proof, Store-owned format authority distinct from foundational evidence.
